action_summary: Tests the owner's plan on the repository's own task corpus instead of invented sentences, and reports two defects, both blindness rather than incapacity. (1) probe_effect('network.http.available') returned UNDECIDABLE__NOT_ESTABLISHED in a sandbox whose egress was verified (pypi.org, registry.npmjs.org, api.github.com all HTTP 200); _subjects stripped exactly one qualifier so it asked about 'network.http' and never reached 'network'. The runtime table gained a 'network' entry decided by a short TCP connect, and _subjects now peels every qualifier. This decides the PRECONDITION only -- the adapter and the native fetch_json_knowledge action keep their own SSRF guards, and conflating the two is how 'the network is up' becomes 'read any URL'. (2) A goal stating a URL, a json path and a destination bound neither the URL slot nor the path slot, so knowledge.json.fetch.external was refused NOT_CALLABLE_WITH_WHAT_GOAL_PROVIDES while its URL was in the sentence; goal_compiler already strips URLs as non-paths but the binder had no counterpart. The fix binds only a slot named like a URL and excludes KEY/NAME slots. Also reports, in the owner's favour, that the STRONGER front door -- live_integrated_brain_v1.compile_against_live_registry -- compiles that real task into typed fetch_json_knowledge actions with data flow into a sympy cycle, which my previous six rounds under-reported.
explicit_user_authorization: Owner directive 2026-11-12: is our claim true or are there things that are wrong, what is real and what is not, use the latest research, think from first principles, kill dumb ideas before implementing. /bin/bash spend, zero model dependency, no protected path touched (the registry is owner-protected and was read, never written).

recursive_obs.real_outcome: The machine can now decide whether it has a network, and binds a URL the sentence states instead of discarding it. It was also discovered that the front door I had been measuring for six rounds is the weaker of two.
recursive_obs.required_capability: A sensor that answers UNKNOWN as its own value, so that a premise nobody can see is not silently counted as false, and a binder that either binds a stated value or reports that it cannot, never neither.

obs_solution.losing_routes_reason: An HTTP probe was rejected: it conflates no-route, broken-TLS and host rejection into one fact, and only the first is what the premise means. Adding a network permission anywhere near the adapter was rejected: the precondition is not an authorisation.
